settings.heading: Cut by hand.|Made to travel.
settings.text: Italian leather, shaped slowly in the south of Italy.
We make leather travel pieces the Italian way: slowly, carefully and built to last. Quiet in design, strong in use, and made to move with you.

settings.heading: From hide to heirloom
settings.text: Four steps, all by hand, before a Rano piece is ready for its first journey.

settings.title: Selecting the leather
settings.text: Every hide is chosen by hand for its grain, weight and the way it softens.

settings.title: Cut by hand
settings.text: Patterns are laid out to follow the natural grain, then cut with a blade, piece by piece, so every panel lines up.

settings.title: Stitched to last
settings.text: Dense, even stitching and reinforced handle joints.

settings.title: Finished with intention
settings.text: Edges are smoothed and sealed, hardware checked, the Rano mark pressed in.

settings.heading: Where days move slowly
settings.text: Rano was born in Casarano, a small town in Puglia where craftsmanship is a way of life, not a trend. Long lunches, sea air and an eye for detail shape everything we make.

settings.heading: Real leather, honest work
settings.text: We work only with genuine, full-grain leather, chosen for how it feels in the hand and how it softens over the years. Every line and every stitch is finished with intention.

settings.heading: Not made for one season
settings.text: We don't chase trends. We release a few pieces in small numbers and never restock, so the Rano you carry stays yours. Discretion over display, quality over excess.
Designed in Italy. Carried in Amsterdam. Made for the world.

settings.heading: La dolce vita, on the move
settings.text: Watch the Rano story, from Puglia to Amsterdam.
